name: Coventry University
description: Coventry offers more than 130 undergraduate degrees and 100 postgraduate degrees over its four faculties, including interesting and unique subjects such as disaster management at undergraduate level (the first such course in the UK), parapsychology, and health journalism. Nationally, Coventry is ranked 13th by The Guardian University league tables 2019, 44th by The Times and Sunday Times University Guide 2019 and 53rd by The Complete University Guide 2020. Internationally, Coventry is ranked within the top 531–540 universities in the world by the 2020 QS World University Rankings. Timestamps Updated
